Vendored PDF generation assets
Retrieved 2026-11-12. These files are served locally by the static app.
No npm installation, runtime CDN requests or build step is needed.

pdf-lib 1.17.1 (MIT)
Official project: https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib
Browser ESM: https://unpkg.com/pdf-lib@1.17.1/dist/pdf-lib.esm.min.js
License: https://unpkg.com/pdf-lib@1.17.1/LICENSE.md
Local import: ./vendor/pdf-lib.esm.min.js (named PDFDocument, rgb, etc.)
Unmodified official browser ESM bundle.

@pdf-lib/fontkit 1.1.1 (MIT)
Official project: https://github.com/Hopding/fontkit
Browser ESM: https://unpkg.com/@pdf-lib/fontkit@1.1.1/dist/fontkit.es.min.js
Upstream fontkit license (the fork/npm package declares MIT but omits LICENSE):
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/foliojs/fontkit/d65a577ea30bfce9ce84dc8045860b2abbc1968b/LICENSE
Local import: ./vendor/fontkit.es.min.js (default fontkit)
Adaptation: the first bare import from "pako" was changed to "./pako.esm.js".
All remaining source is unchanged. This makes browser ES-module loading work
without an import map or build system.
Original download SHA256:
911B7B69F220BAFF71BF123A15B16A8153ED46E68EEEDFC224226D4C4EC967E7

pako 1.0.11 (MIT, bundled zlib portions under the zlib license)
Official project: https://github.com/nodeca/pako
Compatible with fontkit's declared pako ^1.0.6 dependency.
Source: https://unpkg.com/pako@1.0.11/dist/pako.min.js
License: https://unpkg.com/pako@1.0.11/LICENSE
Additional zlib notice: https://unpkg.com/pako@1.0.11/lib/zlib/README
Local module: ./vendor/pako.esm.js
Adaptation: the unmodified UMD source is enclosed by module/exports variables
and followed by `export default module.exports;`. No global pako is created.
Original download SHA256:
29CFA0542B9864B6640CFDCC8F15B184DB6431B532DB2702A3CE97E5F2A7FC1C

Noto Sans Regular/Bold 2.008 (SIL Open Font License 1.1)
Official project: https://github.com/notofonts/noto-fonts
Pinned repository revision: ffebf8c1ee449e544955a7e813c54f9b73848eac
Unmodified hinted static TTFs:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/notofonts/noto-fonts/ffebf8c1ee449e544955a7e813c54f9b73848eac/hinted/ttf/NotoSans/NotoSans-Regular.ttf
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/notofonts/noto-fonts/ffebf8c1ee449e544955a7e813c54f9b73848eac/hinted/ttf/NotoSans/NotoSans-Bold.ttf
License:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/notofonts/noto-fonts/ffebf8c1ee449e544955a7e813c54f9b73848eac/LICENSE
Local fonts: ./vendor/fonts/NotoSans-Regular.ttf and NotoSans-Bold.ttf

Usage/API verified against official documentation:
https://pdf-lib.js.org/docs/api/classes/pdfdocument#registerfontkit
https://github.com/Hopding/pdf-lib#embed-font-and-measure-text

import { PDFDocument } from './vendor/pdf-lib.esm.min.js';
import fontkit from './vendor/fontkit.es.min.js';
const pdf = await PDFDocument.create();
pdf.registerFontkit(fontkit);
const bytes = await fetch('./vendor/fonts/NotoSans-Regular.ttf')
  .then(response => response.arrayBuffer());
const font = await pdf.embedFont(bytes, { subset: true });

Verification: imported the local ESM modules, embedded both fonts with
subsetting, drew German/French/Polish/Czech text and EUR sign, and saved
a valid PDF 1.7 document. Noto Sans supports European name characters;
it is not an all-Unicode font (for example emoji need another font).
